\ubblockdescription{detection.cwt_ridges}{Finds spikes and troughs of every duration in one pass, each with its own scale: a Mexican-hat template is slid along the trace at sizes from min\_scale\_s to max\_scale\_s, the bright points are joined across sizes into ridge lines, and a long, strong ridge is an event whose duration is read off the size at which it is brightest (Du, Kibbe \& Lin 2006). A straight drift cancels without a detrend window. Tune min\_snr first. A lopsided event (a sharkfin) is found with its scale but its centre sits toward the slow side: put Event shape after it for onset and recovery. Events at a span edge are flagged, not hidden.}

  \ubparam{max\_\allowbreak{}scale\_\allowbreak{}s}{7200.0}{number from 0.02 to 864000}{Largest scale, in seconds. Keep it below the usual spacing of events: above it the hat spans several events and can report their arrangement as one slow event}%

  \ubparam{min\_\allowbreak{}ridge\_\allowbreak{}scales}{6}{whole number from 2 to 200}{A ridge must have a maximum on at least this many scales}%
  \ubparam{max\_\allowbreak{}gap\_\allowbreak{}scales}{3}{whole number from 0 to 20}{A ridge may skip this many scales in a row before it ends}%
  \ubparam{noise\_\allowbreak{}window\_\allowbreak{}s}{3600.0}{number from 1 to 864000}{Width of the window the local noise is measured in, seconds}%
